## Original article text

````markdown
## Description

Denotes the beginning of a series of actions that will only execute if the specified condition is true and the previous [If](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/if) or [Else If](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/else%2Bif) action's condition was false.

## Snippet

```
Else If(True);
```

## Properties

**Returns**: _<span style="color: #c678dd">Void</span>_
**Parameters**: ==_Condition_==

> ==**Condition**==
> _Type: **Boolean**, Default: **[Compare](/wiki/articles/compare)**_
> If this evaluates to true, execution continues with the next action. Otherwise, execution jumps to the next else if, else, or end action at the current level.
````
